title: Bunker
description: Silage bunker / bag registration. Mutable geometry and metadata. Drives the 3D digital twin (S4). Field-level Lamport clocks for offline merge.

type.description: Silage storage structure type. Determines 3D twin geometry.

dimensions.description: True-scale dimensions for 3D twin. All in metres.

wall_angle_deg.description: For bunker silos with sloped walls.

fill_pct.description: Estimated current fill level as % of capacity. Updated by farmer or FPO supervisor.

crop_type.description: FeedType enum key for the ensiled crop. e.g. 'MAIZE_SILAGE', 'SORGHUM_SILAGE'.

ensiling_date.description: Date the bunker was sealed / ensiling started. Used for fermentation phase calculation.

opening_date.description: Date the face was first opened for feedout. Triggers aerobic spoilage risk model.

face_direction.description: Cardinal direction of the feed-out face. For feedout planning in the 3D twin.

probe_positions.description: Registered probe lance positions in the bunker coordinate system. Origin = NW corner, +X = East, +Y = Up, +Z = South.

photo_ids.description: UUIDv7s of bunker photos stored in MinIO.

cover_material.description: Sealing material type. Affects O₂ ingress model.

fermentation_phase.description: FermentationPhase enum key. Derived from probe readings, updated by the cloud on each sync.

latest_fqi.description: Latest Fermentation Quality Index (0–100). Derived on the cloud, synced back.

feedout_recommendation.description: Latest feedout recommendation from the spoilage forecast model.
